golden_opportunity_income: 🎉 Golden and Unprecedented Opportunity: Earn Income by Referring People to the National Dentalit Plan
welcome_dentalit_referral_club: Welcome to the “Dentalit Referral Club”! If you are looking for a very simple, professional, and reliable way to earn income, this special opportunity has been designed for you. In this section, all the details are explained in simple language so that you can easily benefit from this great plan.
dentalit_description: Dentalit is a large national plan established through the strong participation of Bank Tejarat and the Iranian Dental Association. The goal of this platform is to ensure that no one postpones their oral and dental health due to high costs. On this platform, all citizens can receive up to 150 million tomans in dental credit from Bank Tejarat completely online and pay their treatment costs in 12 installments.
exciting_news: ✨ Exciting News: Combining Credits for Greater Income!
exciting_news_description: The exciting news is that other reputable banks will soon join this national plan as well. This means people will be able to combine the credits they receive from several different banks in the Dentalit system and have much greater purchasing power. What does this mean for you? Transaction amounts will increase significantly, and as a result, your income from each referral will increase considerably!
financial_benefits: What Are the Financial Benefits of This Plan for You?
financial_benefits_description: You can earn exceptional income by referring people who need dental services. This process is completed in three very simple steps:
step_one_description: 1. You register the mobile number of your colleague, friend, or acquaintance on this page.
step_two_description: 2. The referred person registers on the platform and easily receives their credit.
step_three_description: 3. As soon as this person visits a dentist and pays for the services, your reward will automatically be deposited into your account on the platform!
reward_description: Currently, an exceptional incentive plan has been designed for you. Your reward will be equal to 1% of the total transaction amount of the person you referred.
amazing_example_description: If the person you referred uses their full credit limit and spends 150 million tomans at a dental clinic, you will easily receive a cash reward of 1.5 million tomans!
important_note_description: This amazing 1% reward is only available for a short period and will be reduced in the future. So don't miss the opportunity and invite more people while this opportunity is still available.
income_rules: Simple and Important Rules for Continuing to Earn Income:
income_rules_description: To ensure that the system works in the best possible way, there are a few very simple rules:
list_capacity_description: You have a dedicated capacity to refer 20 people.
thirty_day_golden_period_description: Each person you register has exactly 30 days to receive their credit and spend it at a dental clinic.
how_to_refer_more: How Can We Refer More People?
how_to_refer_more_description: As soon as the referred person completes their transaction, two great things happen: first, you receive your cash reward, and second, their spot on your list becomes available! You can then refer a new person in their place and continue this income-generating cycle indefinitely.
income_withdrawal_description: Whenever your total rewards in the system reach 5 million tomans, withdrawal becomes available, and you can request to have this amount transferred directly to your bank account.
